PanelDescription.SourceString: 从异象管理局离开后不久便到了目的地，跟薄荷聊一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shortly after leaving the Bureau of Anomaly Control, I've reached my destination. Let me have a chat with Mint.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 从异象管理局离开后不久便到了目的地，跟薄荷聊一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shortly after leaving the Bureau of Anomaly Control, I've reached my destination. Let me have a chat with Mint.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the tram to pass
Wait for the tram to pass

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯~不愧是我出外勤时最喜欢的味道~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mmm… This is my favorite scent when I'm out on duty.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可可你也闻闻，木头、煦山樱和青苔，咸咸涩涩的石板路，暖融融的人群……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Coco, take a sniff too. The wood, the cherry blossoms, and moss, the salty and bitter stone road, the warm crowd…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 当然，还有海风里热腾腾的食物香气！这就是桥间地的味道啦——
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And of course, the delicious smell of food in the sea breeze! This is the scent of Bridge Crossings—

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这附近街区好吃的都特别多。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There are lots of great places to eat in this area.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 半角广场的噗卡糖果店，百汇巷的猫丸拉面……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Puka Candy at Hankaku Square, Nekomaru Ramen in Baihui Alley…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 噢对！还有卜多力小屋——他们家的热舞章鱼烧最好吃啦！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh yeah! Don't forget the Budoriya—their Dancing Takoyaki are the best!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 说好请你吃大餐，等这个月工资发了，你随便挑！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I promised you a feast, so after I get my paycheck this month, you can choose any place you like!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那我就先道谢了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Thanks in advance.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 铃声响起，栏杆落下……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The bell rings and the barriers lower…

Description.LocalizedString: Pass through the railway and continue forward

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等电车通过后再前进吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I should wait for the tram to pass before moving forward.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 电车通过，跟随薄荷继续前进吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The tram has passed. I should continue following Mint.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 进入半角街，各种各样的店铺让人应接不暇，还好有薄荷介绍。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Entering Hankaku Street, the variety of shops is overwhelming! Thankfully, Mint is here to show me around.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这边这边，前面就是广场啦。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Over here. That's the plaza.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 来到半角街的广场，注意力被一个奇特的塔状建筑吸引……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Arriving at the square in Hankaku Street, my attention is drawn to a peculiar tower-like structure…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 在这边出外勤的时候，我最喜欢买一只碎雪的冰淇淋，啃着蛋卷来广场逛逛。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I love to get a Blizzi ice cream and munch on egg rolls while I wander around in the plaza when I'm on patrol here.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 当然！是午休时间！我才没有偷懒噢！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Of course! We were on lunch break! Definitely not slacking off!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷似乎对这个非常了解，听她介绍一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint seems to know a lot about this. Let me listen to what she has to say.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 离开维特海默塔，继续向着伊波恩前进吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time to leave Wertheimer Tower and continue toward Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在薄荷的带领下走入了一条阴森的小巷……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Following Mint's lead, I entered a dark, eerie alley…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷的东西落在了车里，不过也快到伊波恩了，先自己过去吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint left something in the car, but we're almost at Eibon anyway. I'll head over by myself first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 忽然有人从面前的电话亭里被「吐」出来了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Suddenly, someone was ejected from the phone booth in front of me…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 面前的建筑应当就是艾尔菲德所说的「伊波恩古董店」……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The building in front of me should be the Eibon Antique Shop that Alphard mentioned…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 门似乎并没有上锁，直接进去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The door doesn't seem to be locked… I'll just go in and take a look.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 空荡荡的店里传来了奇特的声音，找到的声音的来源吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Strange sounds are coming from the empty shop. I should find the source.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来是一个铃状的异象，按照它的说法，轻轻地按下它吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So it's a bell-shaped Anomaly… Following what it said, I'll gently press it.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按下铃后，两个人忽然出现，薄荷也在这时恰巧赶到……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After ringing the bell, two people suddenly appeared, and Mint happened to arrive just at that moment…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 因为「好客屋」的特性，塔吉多似乎将我们认定成了……总之，先在巨大的塔吉多手下坚持到效果解除吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Due to the Hospitable House's effects, Taygedo seems to have mistaken us for… Anyway, let's try to survive against the giant Taygedo until the effect wears off!

QuestName.LocalizedString: The End Is Also the Beginning

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「好客屋」的效果解除了，店里的成员也到齐了，先跟大家认识一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Hospitable House's effect has worn off, and all the shop members are here now. Let's introduce ourselves to everyone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 顺利地跟认识了伊波恩的大家，薄荷的任务也完成了，送薄荷离开吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've successfully met everyone at Eibon, and Mint's quest is complete. Let's see Mint off.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （在这边~在这边~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (This way, this way!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 后院有两栋员工宿舍，店内的人都住在那边。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The backyard has two staff dormitories where everyone from the shop lives.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 知道有鉴定师要来，刚才塔吉多和我正收拾着房间和仓库。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Knowing an appraiser was coming, Taygedo and I were just tidying up the rooms and storage.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （鉴定师，待遇一流！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Top-notch treatment for the appraiser!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就在这里，一层比较方便。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Here we are, it's more convenient on the first floor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随阿德勒先生去看看他和塔吉多精心准备的房间吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's follow Adler to see the room he and Taygedo have carefully prepared.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了自己的房间，听阿德勒先生介绍一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now that I'm in my room, let's listen to Adler's introduction.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这一天真是经历了许多事……先休息一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What a day… so much has happened… I should get some rest.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 休息的差不多了，去跟伊波恩的大家打个招呼吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've rested enough. Let's go say hello to everyone at Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知道大家在做什么……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder what everyone is up to…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒先生应该清楚大家在哪，先找到他吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adler should know where everyone is. Let's find him first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒先生正在客厅收拾，跟她聊一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adler is tidying up in the living room. Let's have a chat with him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒先生还费心准备了一部手机，要好好收下阿德勒先生的这份心意。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adler went through the trouble of preparing a phone for me. I should gratefully accept his thoughtful gesture.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收好了手机，刚刚阿德勒先生说娜娜莉、早雾和埃德嘉在楼上，去找一下他们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've put away the phone. Adler said that Nanally, Sakiri, and Edgar are upstairs. Let's go find them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到了三人，跟他们打个招呼吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Found the three of them. Let's say hello.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 楼下传来了敲门声，莫不是有客人？下楼看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I hear knocking from downstairs… Could it be a visitor? Let's go down and take a look.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店里多了个陌生人，听一下他的来意吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a stranger in the shop. Let's hear him out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来刚来不久店里就要开张了，听阿德勒先生总结下现在的情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like the shop is about to open soon after I arrived. Let's listen to Adler's summary.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了免费的全家福，出发去照相馆「菲林轨迹」解决店主遇到的问题吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: For the free family portrait, let's head to Film Orbit Studio and solve the shop owner's problem.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了免费的全家福，出发去照相馆「菲林轨迹」解决店主遇到的问题吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: For the free family portrait, let's head to Film Orbit Studio and solve the shop owner's problem.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了免费的全家福，出发去照相馆「菲林轨迹」解决店主遇到的问题吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: For the free family portrait, let's head to Film Orbit Studio and solve the shop owner's problem.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了「菲林轨迹」，柯达正在店门前等待，再了解下具体情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've arrived at Film Orbit Studio. Kodak is waiting at the front door, so let's learn more about the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 大概掌握了情况，进入「菲林轨迹」调查一下……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've got a general grasp of the situation. Let's enter Film Orbit Studio and investigate…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先调查一下一楼的几个区域，看看有没有什么线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's start by investigating a few areas on the first floor to see if there are any clues…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到了不少线索，跟大家交换下意见，总结一下发现吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've found quite a few clues. Let's exchange opinions with everyone and summarize our findings.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Second Floor of the Photo Studio</>
Go to the <blue>Second Floor of the Photo Studio</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一楼调查的差不多了，去二楼看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've pretty much finished investigating the first floor. Let's go check out the second floor.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 有伴生的歧骸。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oddities spotted.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对付这种杂鱼不要弄坏店里的东西！尤其是娜娜莉和早雾！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Don't damage the shop! Especially Nanally and Sakiri!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: OK！那我就稍微抑制一下我这无上的力量吧——
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: OK! I'll restrain my immense power—

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 切，委托条款里有写不需要我们赔偿嘛！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Tch, the contract says we don't have to pay for damages!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 口碑啊口碑！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Reputation, reputation!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 知道啦知道啦……真是麻烦……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Got it, got it… what a hassle…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 刚上到二楼就有些歧骸拦路……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Just got to the second floor and spotted some Oddities blocking the way…

Description.LocalizedString: Investigate the <blue>Second Floor of the Photo Studio</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 泯除了拦路的歧骸，继续谨慎的调查吧，二楼似乎有好几个影棚……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nullified the Oddities that were blocking the way. Let's continue investigating carefully. There seem to be several studios on the second floor…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先调查一下一号影棚……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's start by investigating Studio #1…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看看二号影棚有没有什么值得在意的……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's see if there's anything noteworthy in Studio #2…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续调查三号影棚吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's continue investigating Studio #3.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续调查三号影棚吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's continue investigating Studio #3.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 最后看看四号影棚……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Finally, let me check out Studio #4…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 伤脑筋，都是坏掉的相机，看不出什么问题。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Troublesome, all these broken cameras, can't tell what's wrong.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 从之前的记录来看，店内的设备间可能有一批新购入的数码相机。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: According to records, there might be a batch of new digital cameras in the equipment room.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那边或许能有什么新线索。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We might find more clues there.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 欸，原来真的有人一直在看那些字啊！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh, so someone does read those notes!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 碍事的歧骸又出现了，解决它们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Those troublesome Oddities showed up again. Let's take care of them.

Description.LocalizedString: Investigate <blue>the door of the Equipment Room</>
Investigate <blue>the door of the Equipment Room</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 接下来去设备间看一看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go check out the Equipment Room next.

Description.LocalizedString: Find a way into the <blue>Equipment Room</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 设备间的门好像被锁上了，或许可以通过一直追逐我们的摄影框来消除设备间的门……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Equipment Room door seems to be locked. Maybe I can use that camera frame that's been chasing us to remove the Equipment Room door…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 成功了，进去看看吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Success! Let's go inside and take a look…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 被捕捉到了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Uh oh, caught red-handed…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （看样子又是异象制造的空间，得想办法出去。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Looks like another space created by an anomaly. I gotta find a way to get out.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （这里面的一切，跟真实的场景是相反的……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Everything in here is the opposite of what they are in the world out there…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不小心被摄影框拍到后进入了一个诡异的异象空间，寻找出去的方法吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I was caught by the camera and entered a strange Anomalous Realm. Let's find a way out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （鉴定师！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Appraiser!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 没事吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Are you okay?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯，里面没有什么危险的东西。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Yes, there's nothing dangerous inside.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看来被摄像框捕捉到，就有进入到另一个空间的风险。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Looks like being captured by the viewfinder risks entering another space.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 刚才架子上那些相机，都不见了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The cameras on the shelf just now… they're gone…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 奇怪……我们没有离开过这边。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Strange… we haven't left this area.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可恶啊，线索又中断了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Well great! That's another trail that's gone cold!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到了疑似出口的地方，在异象空间里也发现了一些线索，试试看能不能出去吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Found what looks like an exit, and I also discovered some clues in the Anomalous Realm. Let's see if I can get out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 去三楼再看看吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's check the third floor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 成功离开了异象空间，与大家沟通一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Successfully escaped the Anomalous Realm. Let's fill everyone in on what happened.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Third Floor of the Photo Studio</>
Go to the <blue>Third Floor of the Photo Studio</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来二层没有更多线索了，去三层看一看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like there are no more clues on the second floor. Let's check out the third floor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 又出现了拦路的歧骸，解决它们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Oddities are blocking the way again. Let's take care of them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 三层同样有几个影棚，逐个调查一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The third floor also has several studios. Let's investigate them one by one.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Go to the End of the Corridor

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the end of the <blue>Corridor</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 走廊尽头还有个值得在意的地方……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's also something worth checking out at the end of the hallway…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这个影棚与其他的有些不同……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This studio is a bit different from the others…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 仔细调查这个影棚，看看有没有什么信息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's carefully investigate this studio to see if there's any information.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 结合收集到的各种信息，找到泯除异象的关键点吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's combine all the info we've collected and find the key point to nullify the Anomaly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往位于地下室的暗房看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's head to the darkroom in the basement.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多！再踩到我你就死定了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taygedo! Step on me again, and you're dead!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多才没有……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo did not…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 又进入了和刚刚相似的异象空间，谨慎地寻找离开异象空间的出口吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Another Anomalous Realm… Let's find an exit.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到了异象空间的出口，离开这里吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Found the exit of the Anomalous Realm. Let's get out of here.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这个摄像框鬼鬼祟祟一直跟着，真是烦人！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That sneaky viewfinder keeps following us, so annoying!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续向着地下室前进吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's continue toward the basement.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 又被摄影框捕捉到，进入了异象空间。和前两次一样，寻找出口吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Another Anomalous Realm, similar to the previous two… Let's find the exit.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 又被摄影框捕捉到，进入了异象空间。和前两次一样，寻找出口吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Another Anomalous Realm, similar to the previous two… Let's find the exit.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 又被摄影框捕捉到，进入了异象空间。和前两次一样，寻找出口吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Another Anomalous Realm, similar to the previous two… Let's find the exit.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （OK，安全着陆！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (OK, safe landing!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 去地下室。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's head to the basement.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 轻车熟路地离开了异象空间，继续前往地下室吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Left the Anomalous Realm with ease. Let's continue to the basement.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咳咳……比伊波恩杂物间还大的灰尘……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Cough, cough… more dust than Eibon's storage room…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看来许久没有被使用过了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Looks like it hasn't been used in a long time.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 胶片不被需要之后，这里也逐渐在被遗忘。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: After film became obsolete, this place started to be forgotten.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多，还记得我们看过的那本漫画么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taygedo, remember that manga we read?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这下面，不会也有长出头和脚的——
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Underneath here, there might be heads and feet growing—

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不、不要！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (No, no!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 终于到了地下室，里面应该就是「菲林轨迹」异变的元凶了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Finally made it to the basement. The source of Film Orbit Studio's Anomaly should be in here…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 地下室里有许多陈旧的胶片，从中找出有用的线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are lots of old films in the basement. Let's search through them for useful clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 胶片忽然开始狂乱地舞动，汇聚在一起，充满敌意的异象出现……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The films suddenly start dancing wildly, gathering together as a hostile Anomaly appears…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这应该就是罪魁祸首，泯除它，让「菲林轨迹」恢复原状吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This must be the culprit! Let's nullify it and restore Film Orbit Studio to normal.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 成功泯除了异象，一直困扰着柯达的麻烦应该也结束了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nullified the Anomaly. The troubles that have been plaguing Kodak should finally be over…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 离开「菲林轨迹」，具体情况告知柯达，顺便收取本次委托的报酬吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's leave Film Orbit Studio, fill Kodak in on what happened, and collect our commission reward.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 委托完成，报酬也到手，和柯达道别吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Commission complete, payment received. Let's say goodbye to Kodak.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 实在的老板，就这么被浔忽悠了进去！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What an honest guy, fooled by Hotori just like that!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 怎么能叫忽悠呢？该省省该花花懂不懂？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm not fooling! Spend wisely, save wisely, got it?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我这是在给阿德勒减负，赔钱惹麻烦的小鬼当然不会在意店里的收支状况咯～
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm helping Adler out. Mischief-makers don't care about the shop's finances—

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 上次委托人家里的鱼缸……上上次的路障……你倒是算算，最近几个月赔了多少进去！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The fish tank from the last commission… the roadblock before that… count how much we've lost in recent months!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看看阿德勒愁得，最近又憔悴不少吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Look how worried Adler is, he's aged a lot recently!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咳……说起来，小姐为什么会突然想拍胶片？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Cough… By the way, Lady, why did you suddenly want film photography?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 偶尔走走怀旧路线也不错，何况谁让咱们开的是古董店呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: A little nostalgia isn't bad, plus, we run an antique shop.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咱们伊波恩啊——还是跟有故事的老物件更有缘呢～
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Eibon… just vibes with older things, y'know.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 离开了「菲林轨迹」，回伊波恩吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I left Film Orbit Studio. Let's head back to Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 初次工作十分顺利地完成了，跟伙伴们再交流一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: My first job went really smoothly! Let's chat with my partners a bit more.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真是劳累的一天……早些休息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What a tiring day… I should get some rest.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: q110089_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: q110090_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: q110090_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 难得轻松的早晨，与阿德勒先生沟通，询问是否有什么需要帮忙的地方。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's a rare peaceful morning. Ask Adler if there's anything you can help with.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the guest to come in for a detailed discussion

PanelDescription.SourceString: 神秘来客似乎有事寻求伊波恩的帮助，会是什么呢……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The mysterious visitor seems to need Eibon's help with something. What could it be…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 神秘来客似乎是伊波恩的旧识……他会带来什么样的委托？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The mysterious visitor seems to be an old acquaintance of Eibon… What kind of commission will he bring?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哎呀喂，这个太阳，早知道多涂些防晒。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: My gosh. The sun is burning. Should've used more sunscreen.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 刚才为什么不坐车一起去呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Why didn't we accept his ride?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 他臭显摆，我才不坐，晒死也不坐。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: He's a showoff and I'd rather be dead than be seen sitting in his car.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收到简森的邀请前往斯特利速递了解委托细节，前往和他碰面吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Received an invitation from Jenson to visit Sterry Express to learn about the commission details. Let's meet up with him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在斯特利门口的简森似乎等候多时，与他交谈一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Jenson seems to have been waiting for quite some time at the entrance of Sterry Express. Let's talk to him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随简森进入斯特利，发现周围似乎还有一些新面孔……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I follow Jenson into Sterry Express and notice that there seem to be some unfamiliar faces around…

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Sterry Express</> and the others

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到底是什么样的委托呢……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What kind of commission could it be…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 斯特利相识的生意伙伴到来还需要一些时间，在这个时间里，了解下斯特利的相关成员吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sterry Express's business partners will take some time to arrive. In the meantime, let's get to know the members of Sterry's team.

QuestName.LocalizedString: All Waiting Will Eventually Be Answered

Description.SourceString: 等待<blue>神秘异能者</>的到来
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the <blue>mysterious esper</> to arrive

PanelDescription.SourceString: 交谈中得知邀请函有人数限制，现在还需要一张邀请函，简森相识的神秘异能者拥有复制能力，他会何时到来？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: During the conversation, you learned that the invitations have a limit on the number of people. You'll still need one more invitation. Jenson knows a mysterious esper with copying abilities - when will they arrive?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 神秘异能者来到了斯特利速递，与他交谈一下吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The mysterious esper has arrived at Sterry Express. I should talk to him…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 麦考贝的异能伪造的邀请函具有一定的限制，和斯特利速递约定明天处理此事，先回伊波恩休息一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The invitation forged by Michael Pay's Esper Ability has certain limitations. You've made an appointment with Sterry Express to handle this matter tomorrow, so let's head back to Eibon to rest for now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉和阿德勒正在等候你们回来，和他们交谈一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally and Adler are waiting for you to return. Go talk to them.

Description.SourceString: 等待第二天的到来（<blue>15点30分-16点</>）
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the next day to arrive (<blue>3:30–4:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 明天还有和斯特利的约定……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I still have that promise with Sterry tomorrow…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 赶到了和斯特利约定的地方，与九原交谈一下。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've arrived at the place you promised to meet Sterry. Talk to Jiuyuan.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>九原</>乘车前往目的地
Description.LocalizedString: Take a ride with <blue>Jiuyuan</> to the destination

PanelDescription.SourceString: 九原告知了签售会的位置，需要开车前往……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Jiuyuan told me the location of the signing event. I'll need to drive there…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 正在前往签售会的路上……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Heading to the signing event…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 距离签售的具体位置还有一些距离，正在前往的路上……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's still some distance to the actual venue. Let's head over there…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊，西汀！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ahhhh, Settyn!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 西汀！西汀！西汀！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Settyn! Settyn! Settyn!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 西汀！！你是最棒的！！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Settyn!!! You're amazing!!!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 天啊，好多人，不知道能不能排到我……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh my, so many people! I wonder if I'll ever get to the front…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就算只能远远看到本尊，今天的应援也值了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Even just seeing him from all the way out here makes my day!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呜呜，等了好久，没拿到签名真的会很可惜哎。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Waah, I waited all this time… It'll be such a bummer if I can't even get an autograph.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 签售会的现场有一些粉丝……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are some fans at the signing event…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 签售会的现场有一些提前到达的粉丝，与保安交谈了解下最新的情报吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are some fans who arrived early to the event. Let's talk to the security guard to get the latest intel.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 似乎签售会提前结束了，保安让大家请回，九原告知了新的计划，需要前往目标的离场通道。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems the signing event ended early and security is asking everyone to leave. Jiuyuan informed us of a new plan - we need to head to the target's exit route.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待目标出现……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Waiting for the target to appear…

QuestName.LocalizedString: Real Rock vs. Fake Invitation Showdown

PanelDescription.SourceString: 目标出现，他的身上有邀请函，与哈索尔一起完成邀请函的替换计划。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The target has appeared and has an invitation on him. Work with Hathor to complete the invitation replacement plan.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 目标出现，他的身上有邀请函，与哈索尔一起完成邀请函的替换计划。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The target has appeared and has an invitation on him. Work with Hathor to complete the invitation replacement plan.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 完成了邀请函的替换后，需要回到斯特利速递与简森等人会合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After completing the invitation replacement, return to Sterry Express to reconvene with Jenson and the others.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 简森已经在斯特利等候，和他沟通下关于邀请函替换的事情。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Jenson is already waiting at Sterry. Talk to him about the invitation replacement.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 邀请函替换的事情已经完成，接下来返回伊波恩吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The invitation replacement has been completed. Now let's return to Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与浔交谈，传递简森的消息。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to Hotori and deliver Jenson's message.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the next day to arrive (<blue>6:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待新的一天……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait for tomorrow…

QuestName.LocalizedString: This Trip Has Only One Purpose

PanelDescription.SourceString: 新的一天已经到了，是时候前往卡佩大酒店与众人会合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A new day has arrived. It's time to head to The Kapé Grand Hotel and meet up with everyone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在晚上6点，于卡佩大酒店门口，与众人会合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meet up with everyone at 18:00 at the entrance of The Kapé Grand Hotel.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 人都到齐了，是时候进入卡佩大酒店。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everyone has gathered. It's time to enter The Kapé Grand Hotel.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 惠比寿拍卖行一直是卡佩大酒店最大的幕后投资者，酒店为满足惠比寿的联络需求而建立。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ebisu Auction House is the Kapé most important secret investor. The hotel is built for Ebisu's networking needs.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 现代艺术大师<blue>拉赫曼</>参与设计，商船从世界各地运输珍稀物料，不计资金和人力投入，让酒店得以在一年内完工。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Designed with modern art master <blue>Rahman</>, the hotel was completed in just one year—no expense spared, with rare materials shipped in from across the world.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 定期举办的沙龙、公开或邀请制拍卖会，都恰到好处地满足了「某些人」的期待。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The salons and auctions here perfectly meet the expectations of certain people.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 因此这里算得上是惠比寿人际网络的核心之一。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's a hub for Ebisu's network.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 简森对这里似乎颇为熟悉，接下来就跟随他进入惠比寿拍卖厅。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Jenson seems quite familiar with this place. Follow him into the Ebisu Auction Hall.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 惠比寿的邀请函有额外的检查环节，可以顺利通过吗……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Ebisu invitation has additional verification steps. Will it pass smoothly…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 顺利通过了检查环节，接下来需要乘坐电梯。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Successfully passed the security check! Next, I need to take the elevator.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续跟随简森，直到进入拍卖的地方。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Continue following Jenson until entering the auction venue.

QuestName.LocalizedString: When the Door Begins Moving Again

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>简森</>进入<blue>B2-惠比寿拍卖厅</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 地下二层是举办拍卖会的场所，安保措施非常严密，只有受到邀请的客人，才能前往。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The auctions are held in the second basement, with tight security—only the invited can enter.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那就希望，我们这样的小意外……能够无伤大雅吧~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Then let's hope our little mishap… won't cause too much of a stir.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这些画作是拍卖会展示的历届拍品，均价过亿。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: These paintings on display are previous lots, all auctioned for over a hundred million.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 艺术么……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Art…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对于某些人而言，拥有艺术史，比拥有一副价值过亿的画作更为重要。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: For some, owning a piece of art history is more valuable than the billions of Fons the painting represents.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就像比起异象的能力，对异象的收藏品味才更受人瞩目。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And collecting anomalies is more about taste than their abilities.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 所以买家本人也会到场？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So, the buyer's coming in person?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 到场多数是和我们一样的<blue>「替身」</>。拍卖开始前，雇主会将心仪拍品的预期价告知代理。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Most of the people here are just <blue>stand-ins</> like us. Employers tell the agents their max bid beforehand.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 如果在预算内顺利拍下，除了商定的佣金比例，预期价与成交价的差额还可作为代理奖金。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: If we win, any amount saved under the budget will be added to our commission as a bonus reward.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这么好赚，看来我们的委托费还是要低了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So lucrative! Maybe we're not charging enough.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哈哈，承蒙浔小姐的关照，这次就当是卖我们个人情吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Haha, thanks for your generosity, Hotori. Let's call this a favor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 周围的装修还真是豪华，继续跟随简森，最好不要走散了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The decor around here is really luxurious! I should continue following Jenson and try not to get separated.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 周围的装修还真是豪华，继续跟随简森，最好不要走散了。

PanelDescription.SourceString: 拍卖会场已经聚集了不少人，这里大概就是拍卖的地方了吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The auction venue has already gathered quite a few people. This must be where the auction takes place…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 斯特利的三人已经完成伪装混入其中，找到他们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The three from Sterry have completed their disguises and are blending in. Let's find them.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hotori seems to have had a lot of Bacchus, and people around her are noticing her behavior.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 竞拍成功后，与众人交谈下吧。

PanelDescription.SourceString: 中场休息时间，哈尼娅似乎有什么发现……

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅和伊里卡似乎有什么发现，会是什么？

PanelDescription.SourceString: 中场休息的时间里，九原似乎有会对你说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: During the intermission, Jiuyuan seems to have something to tell you…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 时间差不多了……该返回座位等待下一场拍卖开始。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time's almost up… I should return to my seat and wait for the next auction to begin.

Description.LocalizedString: Take your seat and wait for the next auction

PanelDescription.SourceString: 时间差不多了……该返回座位等待下一场拍卖开始。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time's almost up… I should return to my seat and wait for the next auction to begin.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师！快来快来！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Come quick, come quick!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你找鉴定师做什么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What do you want with the Appraiser?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先去外面寻找一下线索吧。门外似乎有人在谈论些什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's check outside for clues. Sounds like someone's talking out there.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （摇滚吗……唱片机失窃时，似乎正在播放摇滚唱片。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Rock music, huh… The record player was playing rock when it disappeared.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （或许，他们提到的音乐声与失窃事件有关。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Maybe the music they mentioned has something to do with the theft.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （先去噗卡糖果店看看吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I should check out Puka Candy first.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 噗卡糖果屋播放了违和的摇滚音乐，去那边调查一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Puka Candy is playing some jarring rock music. Let's go investigate over there.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Strange Sounds at the Candy House

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向店员询问一下情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's ask the staff about the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去白鲸书店调查一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go investigate Moby-Dick Bookstore.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 书店里的读者看起来很气愤，或许他知道些什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The reader in the bookstore looks quite angry. Does he know something?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 音乐声往9℃咖啡厅的方向去了，过去调查一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The music went toward 9°C Coffee. Let's go investigate.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 有位顾客看起来很生气，去询问一下情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a customer who looks very angry. Let's go ask about the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按照顾客所指的方向，寻找声音的去向吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's follow the customer's direction and find where the music is going.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （……确实能听到音乐声从伊波恩传来。发生了什么？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (…Music's indeed coming from Eibon. What's going on in there?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 音乐声从伊波恩里传来……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The music is coming from inside Eibon…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （好大的声音……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (It's so loud…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （莫非是先前的线索链错了？或者，是有谁想要嫁祸伊波恩？还是说……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Could it be that my clues were wrong? Or is someone trying to frame Eibon? Or maybe…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （音乐声是从二楼传来的。姑且先上去看看情况吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (The music is from the second floor. I should head up there and check it out.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 声音从二楼传来，上去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The sound is coming from the second floor. Let's go up and take a look.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在二楼寻找声音的来源……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Searching for the source of the sound on the second floor…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来是鬼郎丸吞下了唱片机……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So Kiroumaru had swallowed the record player…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将唱片机交还到唱片店吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's return the record player to the record shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 学生们似乎在聊些什么……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The students seem to be chatting about something…

Description.LocalizedString: Take shelter from the rain with the <blue>Students</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和学生们一起进屋避雨吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go inside with the students to take shelter from the rain.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和名叫银竹的学生聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's chat with the student named Fir.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 留下的学生感到十分担忧。或许身为异象猎人的你，能平息她的不安……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The student who stayed behind feels very worried. Perhaps as an Anomaly Hunter, you could ease her anxiety…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是时候走出洗衣房了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's time to leave the laundromat.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 走进雨中，寻找离开的学生的踪迹……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Walk into the rain and search for traces of the student who left…

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>身着制服的女子</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一位身着制服的女子拦住了你的去路……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A woman in uniform blocks your path…

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>身着制服的女子</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 协助J.T.F队员进行调查……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Assist the JTF Member in conducting the investigation…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随J.T.F队员调查街道……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow the JTF member to investigate the streets…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 出现了！小心！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's here! Watch out!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 巷子里果然出现了「雨人」……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sure enough, Rainmen have appeared in the alley…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将「雨人」全部泯除。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nullify all the Rainmen.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待学生离开……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Waiting for the student to leave…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 事件处理完毕，和J.T.F队员聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The incident has been resolved. Have a chat with the JTF member.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待次日傍晚……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Waiting for the next evening…

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the district where <blue>Rainman</> appears

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去「雨人」出没的街区查看情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the block where Rainmen have been appearing to check the situation…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和毕星聊聊。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Have a chat with Bixing.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这附近……似乎一切正常。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Everything seems normal around here…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里也没有异常情况……向附近的路人打听一下吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: No anomalies here either… Let's ask the people around here.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帮助J.T.F在周围居民区进行调查……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Help JTF conduct investigations in the surrounding residential areas…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向附近的居民打听一下情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask the nearby residents for information about the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「布朗二手电器」旁边的房子异常潮湿，去检查一下情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The house next to Brown's Used Electronics is unusually damp. Go check the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 检查一下房屋的墙壁……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check the walls of the house…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向附近的居民了解一下情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Learn about the situation from the nearby residents…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 综合现有信息，理清线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Compile available info and sort out the clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随毕星继续调查。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Bixing and continue the investigation.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这附近的地面湿漉漉的……但今天一整天都没有下过雨啊。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The ground around here is wet… but it hasn't rained at all today.
Hmm!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 门后有着强烈的异象波动。要小心。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There are strong anomaly fluctuations behind the door. Stay alert.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往废弃仓库进行调查……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to the Abandoned Warehouse and investigate…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 门后有强烈异象波动，先看看仓库大门能否打开……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are fluctuations behind the door, let's check if the warehouse gate can be opened…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 门锁上了，试着找找其它入口吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The door is locked. Try to find another entrance.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不愧是异象猎人，身手不凡！……我去附近找把梯子。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: As expected of an Anomaly Hunter, impressive skills!… I'll go find a ladder.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 二楼似乎还有入口……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There seems to be an entrance on the second floor…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 进入废弃仓库内部……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Enter the abandoned warehouse…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 调查废弃仓库的情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Investigate the abandoned warehouse…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 调查废弃仓库的情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Investigate the abandoned warehouse…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续调查废弃仓库的情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Continue investigating the abandoned warehouse…

Description.LocalizedString: Nullify <blue>Rainmen</> as they leave the warehouse
Nullify <blue>Rainmen</> as they leave the warehouse

PanelDescription.SourceString: 泯除离开仓库的「雨人」！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nullify the Rainman leaving the warehouse!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 事件解决，和毕星聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The incident has been resolved. Let's chat with Bixing.

Description.SourceString: 前往位于<blue>百汇巷</>的<blue>洗衣店</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅新买的衣服落在百汇巷的洗衣店了，帮她去取一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel left her newly bought clothes at the laundromat on Baihui Alley. Help her pick them up.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找找印着Q3的袋子……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Look for a bag with Q³ printed on it…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等哈尼娅来取衣服……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait for Haniel to come pick up her clothes…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅意外的很快就赶来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel arrived surprisingly quickly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将袋子交给哈尼娅吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's give the bag to Haniel.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 趁此机会，和哈尼娅一起去Q3逛逛吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's take this opportunity to browse Q³ with Haniel.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待哈尼娅找店员把衣服更换成正确的款式……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait for Haniel to find staff to exchange the clothes for the correct style…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在服装店里四处转转吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's wander around the fashion store.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在服装店里四处转转吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's wander around the fashion store.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 服装店里都是联名款的衣服，和哈尼娅聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The fashion store is full of collab items. Let's chat with Haniel about them.

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>哈尼娅</>来到角色立牌前

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店里摆放着哈尼娅最喜欢的角色的立牌。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The store displays a standee of Haniel's favorite character.

Description.SourceString: 给<blue>哈尼娅</>和<blue>立牌</>拍合照
Description.LocalizedString: Take a photo of <blue>Haniel</> and the <blue>standee</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帮哈尼娅和立牌合张影吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Help Haniel take a photo with the standee.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和哈尼娅聊聊，将拍好的照片给她看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chat with Haniel and show her the photos you took.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>咔叽玛</>等待<blue>哈尼娅</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅准备请你吃饭，去火炬木大道上的咔叽玛赴约吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel wants to treat you to a meal. Go to Clicky on Torchwood Avenue to meet up with her.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待哈尼娅……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Waiting for Haniel…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哈尼娅！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Haniel!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是没听到吗……？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Did she not hear me…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅出现在不远处，和她打个招呼？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel appears nearby. Should you go say hello to her?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅似乎才刚刚意识到你站在这里，和她聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel seems to have just noticed you standing here. Go chat with her.

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>哈尼娅</>进入<blue>咔叽玛</>店内

PanelDescription.SourceString: 总之先进店吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Anyway, let's go into the store first!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是时候享用美味的食物了~
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time to enjoy some delicious food!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 吃饱喝足，和哈尼娅闲聊一番吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now that you're full and satisfied, why not have a chat with Haniel?

QuestName.LocalizedString: Let's Go Out and Have Some Fun!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去绿墙坡和哈尼娅一起走走吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go to Green Wall Slope and take a walk with Haniel.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 周围的风景很不错，适合放松心情、边走边聊。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The scenery around here is quite nice, perfect for relaxing and having a chat while walking.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 路上出现了一只可爱的小猫，过去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A cute little kitten appeared on the path. Let's go take a look.

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>哈尼娅、小猫</>一起拍张<blue>合照</>
Description.LocalizedString: Take a <blue>photo</> together with <blue>Haniel and the kitten</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不知道我的自拍技术如何……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I wonder if my selfie skills are any good…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅不太擅长拍合照，帮她一起留个影吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel isn't very good at taking group photos, so let's help her take a picture.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 脑海里突然开始自动响起一些悲伤的BGM……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: My brain just started auto-playing some sad BGM…

QuestName.LocalizedString: A Once in a Lifetime Investment Opportunity?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店长说纳库佩达公园里有「千载难逢的投资机会」，过去看看情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The boss mentioned there's a "once-in-a-lifetime investment opportunity" at Nacupeda Park. Let's go check it out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 所谓的投资机会，究竟是……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What exactly is this so-called investment opportunity…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 浔在未闻浦站台，据路人说她有些神志不清……去那里接她回来吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hotori is at Unheard Shores Station platform. According to passersby, she seems a bit out of it… Go there and fetch her.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向好心路人询问一下店长的情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask the kind passersby about Hotori's situation…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知道店长现在的状况如何……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder how Hotori is doing right now…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 已经快到日出时间了，不如看完日出再走吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's almost sunrise. I might as well stay and watch it before I go.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔急匆匆地赶到……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Daffodill hurries over…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 太阳升起，新的一天开始了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The sun rises, and a new day begins.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是时候面对新的一天了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's time to face the new day.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 浔需要鉴定师来「搭把手」？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hotori needs the Appraiser to give a hand?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「宝物」竟然是……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The "treasure" actually turned out to be…

ObjectivesInfo.ObjectiveTips: 回到伊波恩和阿德勒对话

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒先生发来短信说有事要找，去伊波恩大厅找找阿德勒先生吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adler sent a message saying he needs to see me about something. I should head to Eibon Lobby to find him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 既然阿德勒先生分身乏术，那就让鉴定师充当一天的空若代理家长吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Since Adler has his hands full, I'll step in as Sunya's guardian for the day.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 要选一出风景好的地方写生，今天的天气很适合去水菱湖呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I need to find a spot with a nice view for sketching. Today's weather is perfect for a trip to Caltrop Lake.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 如果快乐也可以是被量化的存在，那对「受」来说，就是胡萝卜蛋糕的样子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If happiness could be measured, for Vedana, it would take the shape of a carrot cake.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知不觉已经到了傍晚，时候不早了该回去了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Before I knew it, evening had arrived. It's getting late. Time to head back.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 调查终于有了进展，去郊区找找阿德勒先生和小物吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The investigation has finally made some progress. Time to head to the suburbs and find Adler and Little Thing.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 众人已经探查过现场了，所有的线索似乎都指向了团三郎。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everyone has already examined the scene. All the clues seem to point to Danzaburou.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 会是谁嫁祸给团三郎呢？去食为天找找新的线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Who could have framed Danzaburou? Time to head to Food First and look for new clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真相一切大白，竟然收到了来自团三郎的……谢礼？！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The whole truth has come to light, and I received a… thank-you gift from Danzaburou?!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （发信人的口吻不像是阿德勒先生，但约见的地点却在伊波恩里……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (The sender's tone doesn't sound like Adler, but the meeting place is inside Eibon…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （去看看吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Let's go take a look.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 发信人不像是阿德勒先生的口吻，会是谁呢……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The sender's tone doesn't sound like Adler. Who could it be…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来是「识」发来的短信，作为美食的交换，识讲了一个很久之前的故事。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So the message was from Vinnana. In exchange for the food, Vinnana told me a story from long ago.
